import sqlite3
from match_data_fetcher import MatchDataFetcher, build_enriched_context
conn = sqlite3.connect\('sports_bot.db'\)
conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
match = dict\(conn.execute\('SELECT * FROM matches WHERE id=9'\).fetchone\(\)\)
fetcher = MatchDataFetcher\(\)
data = fetcher.fetch_match_data\(match\)
ctx = build_enriched_context\(match, data\)
# Покажем только блок психологических факторов
for line in ctx.split\('\\n'\):
    if 'ПСИХОЛОГ' in line or 'СИГНАЛ' in line:
        print\(line\)
        # Печатаем следующие строки до ===
        idx = ctx.index\(line\)
        rest = ctx[idx:]
        for l in rest.split\('\\n'\)[1:]:
            if l.startswith\('==='\):
                break
            print\(l\)
        break
" 2>&1)
